key.name: main-slider-excluded
key.summary: Monitors not driven by the main brightness slider
key.description: Monitor ids (MFG:Model:Serial). New monitors are included by default.

key.name: hidden-features
key.description: Entries of the form "monitor-id|HEXCODE" that are not shown in the menu.

key.name: native-brightness
key.summary: Drive monitors from GNOME's own brightness control
key.description: Register each monitor's DDC/CI brightness with GNOME Shell so the built-in brightness slider, keys, OSD and dimming control it. When this is on and at least one monitor is picked up, the extension does not add a brightness slider of its own.

key.name: brightness-map-unmatched
key.summary: Bridge monitors that are not part of the display layout
key.description: Attach DDC/CI brightness to a free logical monitor when no compositor output matches the monitor's connector. Useful in nested or headless test shells whose only output is virtual; leave off on a real desktop.

key.name: show-osd
key.summary: Show the on-screen display when using shortcuts

key.name: increase-brightness
key.summary: Shortcut to increase brightness of the selected monitors

key.name: decrease-brightness
key.summary: Shortcut to decrease brightness of the selected monitors

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log every ddcutil call to the journal
